findings.explanation: The smallest survey size reaching .5 is 1, not the end of the plateau.
Zero raters score .2, so zero cannot be equivalent to .5. Return missing unless interpolation over the gap is explicitly defined.
Only one comparison is defined, and it is a win; undefined comparisons are not losses.
A fraction of wins with no defined comparisons is undefined, not zero.
Derived results must retain the sample identifiers used to align later comparisons.
Ratio results must retain the sample identifiers used to align later comparisons.
Error distances are computed around the bootstrap mean but drawn around the actual score, shifting both endpoints.
